# MusicMix - CORE venv for the Linux (Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, CPU only).
#
# Python: 3.11 (create with uv, NOT the system 3.12). Consumed by
# env/install_python.sh -> /opt/musicmix/venv, i.e. equivalent to:
#   uv venv --python 3.11 /opt/musicmix/venv
#   uv pip install --python /opt/musicmix/venv/bin/python -r env/requirements-core.txt \
#     --index-strategy unsafe-best-match
# Reason: every Windows runtime was CPython 3.11.9 (cp311 wheels) and LinkSeg's
# dgl==1.1.1 only ships wheels up to cp311 (manylinux1_x86_64).
#
# Covers: canonical ingest, Beat This!, Demucs (htdemucs), faster-whisper,
# Silero VAD, spaCy + en_core_web_sm, LinkSeg, SSM-Net, Audiobox-compatible
# base, and the test suite.
# NOT covered here (hard conflict, see env/requirements-legacy-np1.txt):
#   CUE-DETR and SongEval/MuQ need transformers==4.42.3 which pins
#   numpy<2.0, tokenizers<0.20 and huggingface-hub<1.0, whereas the ASR stack
#   below was run with numpy 2.4.6, tokenizers 0.23.3, huggingface_hub 2.2.0.
#
# System packages (apt), not pip:
#   ffmpeg (ingest.py + Demucs AudioFile use the ffmpeg/ffprobe binaries on PATH;
#           Windows runs used "ffmpeg version 9.0-full_build-www.gyan.dev";
#           Ubuntu 24.04 apt ships 6.1 -> see RUNTIME_MAP.md, canonical-hash risk)
#   libsndfile1 (soundfile ships its own manylinux lib, apt copy is optional)
#   rubberband-cli (3.3.0 on Ubuntu 24.04: R3 "--fine" engine + --timemap, used by
#           src/musicmix/dj_render.py for grid-locked beatmatching; fallback is
#           ffmpeg's af_rubberband filter, R2 realtime, constant ratio only)
#
# Versions are the ones found in *.dist-info of the Windows runtimes
# (.cache/*, runs/result_swarm_v12/agents/*/runtime*, global Python 3.11
# site-packages and the per-user site-packages) unless noted.

# --- DJ selection providers: SEPARATE venv /opt/musicmix/venv-allin1 (2026-10-20) ---
# Not installable in this core venv (torch 2.2 / numpy 1.26 / NATTEN source build).
# Used only by tools/dj_providers.py; tools/dj_plan_pool.py and
# src/musicmix/dj_select.py run in the core venv with the packages above.
# Recreate with (uv, Python 3.11, CPU):
#   uv venv --python 3.11 /opt/musicmix/venv-allin1
#   uv pip install --python /opt/musicmix/venv-allin1/bin/python \
#     --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu --index-strategy unsafe-best-match \
#     torch==2.2.2+cpu torchaudio==2.2.2+cpu numpy==1.26.4 "cython<3" "scipy<1.14" mido setuptools==79.0.1 wheel
#   uv pip install --python ... --no-build-isolation natten==0.14.6      # PyPI sdist, CPU build (~10 min)
#   uv pip install --python ... --no-build-isolation \
#     "madmom @ git+https://github.com/CPJKU/madmom@27f032e8947204902c675e5e341a3faf5dc86dae"
#   uv pip install --python ... --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu \
#     --index-strategy unsafe-best-match \
#     "allin1 @ git+https://github.com/mir-aidj/all-in-one@18e78903c0365147a2c5d4e5e57ebf88cb7d800e" \
#     torch==2.2.2+cpu torchaudio==2.2.2+cpu numpy==1.26.4 demucs==4.0.1 librosa==0.10.1 "huggingface_hub<1.0" soundfile
#   uv pip install --python ... essentia==2.1b6.dev1110                  # last cp311 manylinux wheel
# Resolved: allin1 1.1.0, natten 0.14.6, madmom 0.17.dev0, essentia 2.1b6.dev1110,
#   huggingface-hub 0.36.2, demucs 4.0.1. setuptools<81 is required (allin1 imports pkg_resources).
# Weights: All-In-One harmonix-fold0..7 from HF taejunkim/allinone snapshot
#   379e5fd010b3fdd0ee8381ff8cbcfa51d70b5c19 (sha256 per file in runs/dj_plan_v1/providers/*.json);
#   madmom key_cnn.pkl ships inside the madmom git checkout (sha256 recorded likewise);
#   htdemucs 955717e8-8726e21a.th reused from TORCH_HOME=/opt/musicmix/models/torch.
# NATTEN wheels on shi-labs.com were not used (expired TLS certificate on 2026-10-20).
